'''Matt Seiber''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[2001 Virginia State Championship]] on 26 May 2001 with [[Set Your Course For Alderaan / The Ultimate Power In The Universe|flipping SYCFA]], according to Wes Brown's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2396">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-05-30-raptors-return-va-states-26-may-01d2396/ raptors-return-va-states-26-may-01], DeckTech (Wes "SeaRaptor" Brown, 30 May 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-05-30-raptors-return-va-states-26-may-01d2396/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
